Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: alternate lighting background for the same 2D pixel-art historical investigation game location, praca_verde, Rio de Janeiro 1890.
Input image1 is the EDIT TARGET and exact scene/geometry/style reference.
Primary request: change ONLY the time-of-day lighting of the Rio square with its central gazebo, green newspaper kiosk on the right, railings, trees, benches, mountain skyline and front stone pavement to 18:00 sunset, the last warm light of day.
Lighting: a recognizably warm orange-peach sunset sky near the horizon blending into muted lavender blue above; low warm amber sunlight glancing over roofs, walls, foliage and stone pavement; longer cool violet shadows, existing gas lamps and interior lamps softly lit. Keep environment clearly visible and readable, not night.

Geometry and silhouettes must stay aligned with the input because the game swaps these images without changing any colliders or sprite placements. Do not move, delete, add, redesign or reframe scene objects. The front walkable stone pavement must remain at the same height and fully empty.
Style/medium: identical handcrafted warm expressive crisp pixel-art background, stepped raster edges and square color clusters, same pixel density, earthly historical Brazilian architecture. Lighting adjustment, not a new illustration.
Constraints: ONE single full-width opaque background image, same exact landscape crop and content as reference. No new foreground trees, objects, people, animals, words, labels, borders, frames, watermark, UI, gradients obscuring pixel texture or photorealism. Output 2048x768 if possible. Keep matching landmarks pixel aligned.
